chunks: Abu Basir asked him about a man who had intercourse with his wife while he was in the state of ihram. He said:
peace be upon him: “Upon him is a large camel (jazur kawmā’).”
He said, “He cannot afford it.” He, peace be upon him, said: “It is fitting for his companions to gather for him, and they should not spoil his hajj for him.”

key_terms.جَزُورٌ: a camel offered as sacrificial compensation
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram during hajj or 'umrah

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for having intercourse with one’s wife while in the state of ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a muhrim who has intercourse with his wife during hajj, stating that a large camel is due as expiation. If he cannot afford it, his companions should assist him financially so that his hajj is not ruined.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2589 - Abu Basir asked Imam (as) about a man who had intercourse with his wife while in the state of Ihram.
Imam (as) said: "He must offer a large camel (jazur kawmā’)."

Abu Basir said: "What if he cannot afford it?"
Imam (as) replied: "It is upon his companions to contribute on his behalf, and they should not invalidate his Hajj."
